description:
The falsifier for one specific paper's core claim: the concrete
    observation, experiment, or computation that would settle or disprove
    it, plus how many people are watching for that result. Use this when the
    user asks what would falsify the paper, prove it wrong, test its central
    claim, settle the claim, or show that the conclusion fails.

arxiv_id.description: Any form the user gave: bare arXiv id (2401.00001), arXiv abs/pdf URL, DOI or doi.org URL, or Pith Number.
arxiv_id.title: Arxiv Id

name: get_paper_falsifier
title: Get the test or result that could disprove a paper
